details.title: LC 1: Two Sum
details.intuition: Hash map complement lookup in single pass.
details.trigger: Unsorted array + Pair Sum -> 1-pass Hash Map complement lookup in O(N).
details.invariant: At step i, all elements before i are in map. We check target - nums[i] BEFORE inserting.
details.pitfall: Do NOT insert before checking, or element might pair with itself.

nodes.name: LC 121: Best Time to Buy & Sell Stock

details.title: LC 121: Best Time to Buy & Sell Stock
details.intuition: Track running min buy price and maximize profit.
details.trigger: Single buy & sell in sequence -> Track running minimum price seen so far.
details.invariant: Max profit at day i = max(0, price[i] - min_price_seen_so_far).
details.pitfall: Prices strictly decreasing -> answer is 0, never negative.

details.title: LC 242: Valid Anagram
details.intuition: 26-int frequency count comparison in single pass.
details.trigger: Permutation character match -> 26-int frequency signature in single pass.
details.invariant: Lengths must match; +1 for s and -1 for t leaves all counts at exactly 0.
details.pitfall: Check s.length() == t.length() first before allocating memory.

details.title: LC 49: Group Anagrams
details.intuition: Sort string or 26-char count signature as canonical hash map key.
details.trigger: Group equivalent anagram strings -> Canonical key hash map.
details.invariant: Two strings share identical key iff they have identical character counts.
details.pitfall: Sorting string key takes O(K log K); 26-char count tuple takes O(K).

details.title: LC 347: Top K Frequent Elements
details.intuition: Frequency hash map + O(N) bucket sort array by counts.
details.trigger: Top K elements with bounded frequency -> Bucket Sort by count.
details.invariant: Max possible frequency is N. Bucket array of size N+1 gives O(N) linear time.
details.pitfall: Heap approach is O(N log K); Bucket Sort achieves true linear O(N).
details.ladder_prev: LC 215: Kth Largest Element in an Array

nodes.name: LC 238: Product of Array Except Self

details.title: LC 238: Product of Array Except Self
details.intuition: Prefix product array in-place + running reverse suffix product.
details.trigger: Product of all except self WITHOUT division -> Prefix & Suffix running products.
details.invariant: ans[i] = (product of elements < i) * (product of elements > i).
details.pitfall: In-place prefix pass in output vector + reverse suffix scalar gives O(1) auxiliary space.

details.title: LC 128: Longest Consecutive Sequence
details.intuition: Hash set lookup; only count streaks starting where (x-1) is not in set.
details.trigger: Unsorted consecutive sequence in O(N) -> Hash Set streak start check.
details.invariant: Only start counting streak at x if (x - 1) is NOT in the set.
details.pitfall: Without the (x - 1) check, complexity degrades to O(N^2) on long chains.

details.title: LC 560: Subarray Sum Equals K
details.intuition: Running prefix sum with hash map frequencies. Lookup prefix - k.
details.trigger: Contiguous subarray sum with negative numbers -> Running Prefix Sum + Hash Map.
details.invariant: Subarray [j+1, i] sums to k iff prefix[i] - prefix[j] == k.
details.pitfall: MUST initialize map[0] = 1 to count subarrays starting from index 0.
details.ladder_next: LC 238: Product of Array Except Self

details.title: LC 53: Maximum Subarray
details.intuition: Kadane's algorithm: reset running sum when negative.
details.trigger: Max sum contiguous subarray -> Kadane's running sum reset.
details.invariant: If running sum drops below 0, it can only hurt future subarrays -> reset to 0.
details.pitfall: All-negative arrays: update global max BEFORE resetting running sum.
details.ladder_next: LC 121: Best Time to Buy & Sell Stock

details.title: LC 75: Sort Colors
details.intuition: Dutch National Flag 3-pointer partition for 0, 1, and 2.
details.trigger: 3 distinct values in-place -> Dutch National Flag 3-pointer partition.
details.invariant: [0..low-1] is 0, [low..mid-1] is 1, [high+1..N-1] is 2.
details.pitfall: After swap(mid, high), decrement high but do NOT advance mid (incoming value unknown!).

details.title: LC 54: Spiral Matrix
details.intuition: 4 boundary pointers (top, bottom, left, right) layer peeling.
details.trigger: Clockwise 2D layer traversal -> 4 boundary pointers (top, bottom, left, right).
details.invariant: Peel outer rectangular perimeter, then shrink boundaries inward.
details.pitfall: Check top <= bottom before moving Left, and left <= right before moving Up.

nodes.name: LC 167: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted

details.title: LC 167: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
details.intuition: Opposite direction two pointers on sorted array.
details.trigger: Sorted array pair sum -> Opposite direction Two Pointers (l, r).
details.invariant: sum > target -> r--; sum < target -> l++. Sorted order strictly eliminates candidates.
details.pitfall: Problem requires 1-based indices in result.

details.title: LC 15: 3Sum
details.intuition: Sort array, fix first element, two pointers for remaining pair.
details.trigger: Triplets summing to 0 -> Sort array, fix nums[i], two pointers on remaining pair.
details.invariant: Sorting enables Two Sum II + easy duplicate elimination by skipping equal elements.
details.pitfall: Skip duplicate elements with while loops guarded by l < r to prevent out-of-bounds.
details.ladder_prev: LC 167: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted

details.title: LC 11: Container With Most Water
details.intuition: Greedy two pointers: always advance shorter vertical boundary inward.
details.trigger: Max area between two vertical lines -> Greedy Two Pointers from extremities.
details.invariant: Area = min(h[l], h[r]) * (r - l). Always move the SHORTER line inward.
details.pitfall: Moving the taller line while decreasing width cannot possibly increase area.

details.title: LC 3: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
details.intuition: Sliding window with last seen character index map.
details.trigger: Contiguous substring with all distinct chars -> Dynamic Sliding Window.
details.invariant: Window [l..r] contains no duplicates. Jump l to last_seen[c] + 1 on duplicate.
details.pitfall: l = max(l, last_seen[c] + 1) to prevent l from jumping backward to stale indices.

details.title: LC 424: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
details.intuition: Window len - max_freq <= k invariant.
details.trigger: Longest substring after k flips -> Dynamic Window with frequency invariant.
details.invariant: Window valid if (window_len - max_frequency) <= k.
details.pitfall: max_freq never needs to decrement on shrink; only a strictly higher max_freq expands the record.
details.ladder_prev: LC 3: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters

details.title: LC 567: Permutation in String
details.intuition: Fixed window of size s1.length() tracking 26 character matches.
details.trigger: Contiguous substring anagram -> Fixed-size window of length s1.length().
details.invariant: Window slides 1 step: subtract outgoing char, add incoming char in O(1).
details.pitfall: Maintain a matches counter (0..26) for O(1) comparison rather than 26-vector diff.
details.ladder_next: LC 438: Find All Anagrams in a String

details.title: LC 209: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
details.intuition: Dynamic sliding window expanding R and shrinking L while sum >= target.
details.trigger: Shortest subarray with sum >= target (positive numbers) -> Dynamic Sliding Window.
details.invariant: Monotonicity holds because all numbers are positive. Expand r; shrink l while sum >= target.
details.pitfall: If array contained negatives, sliding window fails -> requires Prefix Sum + Monotonic Deque.
details.ladder_next: LC 713: Subarray Product Less Than K

details.title: LC 42: Trapping Rain Water
details.intuition: Water bounded by min(left_max, right_max) - height[i].
details.trigger: Water trapped above elevation bars -> Height bounded by min(left_max, right_max).
details.invariant: Bottleneck is always the smaller boundary. If left_max <= right_max, process left & advance.
details.pitfall: Two pointers eliminates the O(N) memory requirement of prefix/suffix arrays to O(1) space.

details.title: LC 1004: Max Consecutive Ones III
details.intuition: Dynamic window with at most K zero flips.
details.trigger: At most k zero flips to 1 -> Longest window with <= k zeros.
details.invariant: zero_count <= k. Expand r counting zeros; shrink l when zero_count > k.
details.pitfall: Window size can be maintained non-shrinking for optimal 1-pass O(N).

nodes.id: prob:LC 713: Subarray Product Less Than K
nodes.name: LC 713: Subarray Product Less Than K

details.title: LC 713: Subarray Product Less Than K
details.intuition: Subarray counting: count += (r - l + 1) while product < k.
details.trigger: Subarray product < k (positive numbers) -> Dynamic Sliding Window with count += (r - l + 1).
details.invariant: Every valid subarray ending at index r has starting indices in [l..r], giving (r - l + 1) subarrays.
details.pitfall: k <= 1: return 0 immediately since all positive integers >= 1.

details.title: LC 438: Find All Anagrams in a String
details.intuition: Fixed window size p.length() matching character frequency map.
details.trigger: All starting indices of anagram substring -> Fixed window of size p.length() with running character counts.
details.invariant: Only 2 chars change per slide: evict left s[i-m], admit right s[i]. Equal freq vector = anagram match.
details.pitfall: Off-by-one: accessing s[r+1] after r++ skips characters and overflows. Use canonical 1-loop (i and i - m).

details.title: LC 904: Fruit Into Baskets
details.intuition: Longest contiguous subarray with at most 2 distinct elements.
details.trigger: Longest contiguous subarray with at most 2 distinct elements -> Dynamic Sliding Window with hash map.
details.invariant: Window valid iff map.size() <= 2. When map.size() > 2, shrink l until key hits 0 and erase.
details.pitfall: Must call map.erase() when frequency drops to 0, otherwise map.size() still counts empty key.

details.title: LC 33: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
details.intuition: Identify which half is sorted; check if target falls in sorted interval.

details.title: LC 153: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
details.intuition: Compare nums[mid] with nums[right] to find pivot inflection.
details.trigger: Minimum in rotated sorted array in O(log N) -> Compare nums[mid] with nums[r] for inflection point.
details.invariant: If nums[mid] > nums[r], drop is to the right (l = mid + 1). Else mid or left is candidate (r = mid).
details.pitfall: Never do r = mid - 1 on the right-sorted branch, or you will exclude the minimum when nums[mid] is the min.
